title: Accounts-receivable chaser
summary: Chase overdue invoices politely and on policy. Reads your payment provider first so a client who has paid is never chased, picks the right dunning step deterministically, drafts the message, and only sends what you approve (or what your policy envelope allows).
sells_as: AR recovery, 2–5% of recovered value or $300+/mo

requires_connections.name: payments
requires_connections.why: Know whether an invoice has actually been paid, so nobody who has paid is ever chased. Reading only — taking a payment always needs your approval.

requires_connections.name: billing-email
requires_connections.why: Send the reminders, and read the reply when a client says they have already paid.
